label: fixture
_comment: Hand-built dataset mirroring the snapshot format (see scripts/eval-curation-lib.mjs header). Four runs: run-a = healthy, run-b = every failure mode the metrics catch (event-cap break, sports leak, below-threshold score, missing reason, invalid condition_id), run-c = zero-result fallback, run-d = errored trace. fixture-judgments.json carries pre-recorded judge verdicts for every pick so `npm run eval:curation` is fully offline. Regenerate judgment keys with scripts/generate-curation-fixture-judgments.mjs after editing picks.
